items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Explicit profile wins and is resolver-checked; unknown/invalid name is reported loudly (profile null, profile_error, warnings, exit 3), never replaced; project/user profiles resolve via the resolver; run config carries the profile (write-config --profile, e2e test); no profile = unchanged; B2 carry-over reworded in place (net zero lines) with a test and the NEVER rule in brief-intake.md and SKILL.md. brief_intake.py 293 lines.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Resolver error family and ImportError caught and mapped to a closed error; non-string and blank values handled; control characters stripped and messages bounded.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No profile file is opened by path; resolver decides; names validated whole (trailer item not cut at the first word); profile file contents never echoed unsanitized; fixture switch stays operator-only.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 16 unit tests (explicit wins, env follows chosen profile, unknown/invalid, no profile unchanged, project/user, untrusted contents, WebUI trailer, text keys and precedence, CLI exit codes, refusal wording) plus 3 e2e tests through the real CLIs; adopt suite green.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: The resolver is loaded only when a brief names a profile.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New logic in brief_profile.py (107 lines); brief_intake.py shrank to 293; sibling loader folded into one helper; ADR-045 file-path loading.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer: WebUI composeNewBrief (prose trailer) and optional profile field; consumers: brief_intake, adopt (ignores profile), write-config, get-next-step. Real round trip brief file -> intake CLI -> write-config -> run config -> next step probed.
